title: Local IPC error code
description:
Local errors are deliberately MORE precise than the remote wire. A remote peer never receives EndpointUnknown, EndpointDisabled, or EndpointClientKindDenied — those collapse to the coarse `no_route` class so the directed protocol cannot become an endpoint-existence oracle (ADR-0030). Keeping both vocabularies in one repository makes the asymmetry reviewable rather than accidental.

THE ENUM IS THE COMPLETE LOCAL VOCABULARY. It carries every stable category of `contracts/TRANSPORT.md` §Error model, not only the handshake ones: an ordinary command failing with PayloadTooLarge or PeerUnreachable must be representable, and a closed enum missing those makes a conforming failure response invalid at the IPC boundary. `Cancelled` is the one category refined rather than copied — IPC distinguishes CancelledBeforeDispatch from CancellationRaced, because that difference is observable locally and is exactly what a caller needs to decide whether to retry.
